notes.title: 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
1. Optimized graphics settings and some localized translation displays.
2. Fixed an issue where the game would become unresponsive when encountering ghostly hair creatures on certain configurations.
3. Defaulted to hiding character models, which can be manually enabled in settings.

notes.title: 1.0.4 Update: Difficulty Adjustment and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
1.The timing judgment for the "27's Cat" is now more lenient; you no longer need to make an abrupt stop to avoid being killed by the cat XD
2.The text shattering effect no longer applies during every seventh "one", which is the safest time. The rules will now be clearly visible!
3.Fixed the bug where the bird hint appeared too early.
4.Optimized the text explaining the final rule of the "First Seven".

notes.title: 1.0.3 Version Update
notes.content:
1.Fixed the issue where the scroll box was difficult to scroll with the mouse wheel.
2.Added an option to hide character models, enabling a pseudo-first-person perspective.
3.Removed the opening subtitles in the Simplified Chinese version.
4.Added Easter eggs.

notes.title: The game is released!
notes.content: Thank you all for your support! We hope everyone enjoys playing! If you encounter any issues during the game, you can join the Discord:https://discord.gg/RtqrNpt2 to feedback!
